# Initialize localized view caches before their dereferencing consumers

Current InitializeDBViewStrings calls InitializeLiterals and clears the connector cache. InitializeLiterals allocates the translated strings into StaticAutoPtr fields, and FetchPriority dereferences those fields. Replacing the old global string constructors changes storage, but does not remove this explicit initialization contract. Check the service initialization and readers together when changing this cache. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mailnews/base/src.
